item.title: Pulse 1.6.1

item.title: Pulse 1.6.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 1.6.0 — in-app updates - fix(about): public links go to pulse-releases; drop the private source link - build(updates): pin Sparkle 2.10.1 for project-level builds too - feat(about): Updates section on the About page - feat(release): publish on pulse-releases with a signed Sparkle feed - feat(updates): Sparkle 2 updater with gentle reminders and update-safe quit - docs(ai): builder-check calls and two open questions - docs(ai): draft design to compete with Sentient OS (awaiting user)
SHA-256: `00466e4b267342c72ef8228558131f7ac91ad9b8d3a453af208ca882c00e11fa`
